fusions.name: Scurry Shot
fusions.desc: Looses 3 short arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. You move 12% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Peephole Shot
fusions.desc: An arrow loosed from hiding at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and ignores armour. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Covering Swarm
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 32% further. For the first 6 seconds, an escort of rats strikes your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Pincushion
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
